data.name: 6hr Private Boat Tour
data.headline: 6 hours • Private charter • All ages
data.description:
# Enjoy the beauty of Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands exactly your way!

##About
The boat is all yours with your own captain. Design your own tour from the many things we do – Marco sightseeing, history, eco-tour, dolphins, shelling, etc.

##Provided
- Cooler with ice
- Shelling bags
data.cancellation_notes:
- Full refund if canceled 48+ hours before the tour.
- Cancellation insurance is available for any tour or ticket.
- No refunds for cancellations within 48 hours or late arrivals.
- Partial refund if the tour ends early for weather or safety reasons.
- Rescheduled tours can be subject to a rescheduling fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
- Any canceled tours can be subject to a fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
